crossRefs.note: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld…
“Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.
“Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t…
She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.
Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I…
A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

translations.web: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”
translations.bsb: Let your eyes be on the field they are harvesting, and follow along after these girls. Indeed, I have ordered the young men not to touch you. And when you are thirsty, go and drink from the jars the young men have filled.”
translations.kjv: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.
translations.asv: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.
